title.name: The founder scorecard and goal setting

overview.description: Orientation-week baseline. A scorecard exists so that in week 12 you can tell whether the ninety days moved anything, rather than reasoning from how tired you feel.
objectives: Set goals with a number and a date attached
Distinguish leading from lagging indicators for a company with no revenue
Build an accountability loop that survives a bad week
prerequisites: Orientation: how to read this tree

steps.intro: Orientation-week baseline. A scorecard exists so that in week 12 you can tell whether the ninety days moved anything, rather than reasoning from how tired you feel.
instructions: Score yourself now on: science, customers, capital, team, and your own bandwidth.
Set three goals for the ninety days. Each needs a number and a date.
Name the one metric you would report weekly even if nobody asked.

submission.description: Produce the Founder Scorecard and log it against this module in Homeroom. Done means the artefact exists, not that you read the page.
